text:
clare-peopleops: Heads-up — hiring teams asked for a short calibration session for backend interviews next Tues, want to cover scorecard interpretation differences.

miguel-recruiter: +1. We've seen inconsistent ratings between ICs and hiring managers. Could use a 30-min rubric walkthrough and a sample eval sync.

dina-eng: I can join. Would be helpful to have 3 anonymized scorecards (good/ok/bad) and callouts on where people disagreed.

clare-peopleops: I'll pull examples (sanitized). Question: do we run as a recorded training (asynchronous) or live? Live might be better for Q&A but harder to schedule.

oliver-ops: live is fine; we can run twice to cover EMEA-friendly time. I can reserve rooms and add Zoom + recording.

miguel-recruiter: propose agenda: 1) 10m rubric walk, 2) 10m sample reviews, 3) 10m Q&A + tips (what to ask). Can you add a short prep doc with examples?

clare-peopleops: yes — I'll draft a 1-pager: scoring guide, common pitfalls, how to leave useful notes. Will attach sanitized samples.

dina-eng: also pls include a one-paragraph note for interviewers on "when to change a score after discussion" — we've seen post-hoc edits without notes.

training-bot: Reminder set: schedule training for 2026-05-05 09:00 (UTC) and 2026-05-05 17:00 (UTC).

clare-peopleops: perfect. I'll post invites and an FAQ blurb in #interviewer-announcements once slides are ready. Thanks team!
